description: My take on a standard build for Golden Horde
name: Standard GH Aggression Opener (DLC RELEASE VERSION)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Age up with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_building_carts_age2.webp@ for FC or fast aggro. Age with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_khan_age2.webp@ for standard feudal play or FC with torguuds to harass and prevent relics of FC opp.
Macro 8 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 more to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

@building_military/archery-range.webp@ / @building_military/barracks.webp@ depending on opponent counter. (if cav-archer or spears you go archer, if enemy cav either go more cav or spear to compliment your keshik torguud comp)

Now you go either long feudal and play for @age/age_3.webp@ Yasak Muscovy if you kept Keshiks alive. This age up gives u 200 wood per min so it helps with farms when @resource/deer.webp@ / @resource/boar.webp@ runs out. Add the @building_golden_horde/stockyard.webp@ when you are left with @resource/berrybush.webp@. The other age up is a long game style I'd use for FC into Age 3. @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_relic_ovoos_age3.webp@ will give you plenty of stone to make age 4: @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_stone_armies_age4.webp@ extremely potent, so you can use that as well. It all depends on how the feudal age played out :)

name: Golden Horde Team Match Fast Imperial
author: 特列-苏菲

notes: 4 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ & 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@-> @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ -> @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and gather with that vill
When 2 keshiks 2 torguuds and khan start harassing
Play game out your way. If opp makes units in feudal and u can fight, then play feudal. If they go castle go units, deny res, then castle after them.
Always go @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_lumber_shields_age3.webp@ for 200w/pm and+2 armor. In age 4 both landmarks are good
Start 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on sheep and 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@
Rally 3 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until age up

Age up to @age/age_2.webp@ with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_building_carts_age2.webp@ in @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ and leave 7 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ and rally @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Produce @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ and harass enemy and use @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_building_carts_age2.webp@ to make @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and @building_military/stable.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.webp@ (As needed)
Build @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and rally until 8-10 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ (Remacro as needed)

name: (2026) Fast Keshik + Torguuds Into Aggro/FC - Fast
author: B-SON

Play game out your way. If opp makes units in feudal and u can fight, then play feudal. If they go castle go units, deny res, then castle after them.
Always go @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_lumber_shields_age3.webp@ for 200w/pm and+2 armor. In age 4 both landmarks are good

Always make @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ (or @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@) and harass enemy resources

or send @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @building_mongols/ger.webp@@resource/deer.webp@ with @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ (outpost if needed)

author: murtuk

description: A Build Order to go aggro all-in in Feudal, with Khan & Torguuds + Archers. You can aggro a bit earlier than with Building Carts and produce Torguuds more consistently. Aggressive strat best to deal with civs you don't want to play the long game against like Knights Templars or Ottomans.
name: Golden Horde Feudal All-in with Khan & Torguuds
author: Eldritch

notes: Send 1 to build @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ then @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ (near @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if front because you'll make @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ later on it) and then go @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Send 1 of the 2 new @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and mine
Send 6 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ the next two to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ as well

Produce @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ and @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ from @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ and send to enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to harass, try to keep him alive, dodge @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ near @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ with space for future @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@
Produce 1 @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ batch and rally to the enemy base
Produce @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ as soon as you have 160 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and rally to enemy base, heal @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ if necessary

Once 11 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 14 then send 2-3 more @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Build second production building when necessary, according to enemy composition
Whenever possible build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ and @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@
Research @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ if enemy goes 2 TC and you're in a safe position to push it with 2 rams

description:
As basic as possible (it looks scarier than it is!) Golden Horde build order for new players. Video below!

The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with Torguud, Archer & Spear/Kharash while slowly going to the Castle Age. This can be played on any land map against any* civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games!

Once you get Castle, you can look to end the game early with the help of Muscovy Yasak +2 ranged armour on your Torguud, MAA, and Rus Tributes, or you can save stone and later go for Barracks Reinforcements which is a huge power-spike where the Golden Horde really becomes a horde.

*Against feudal knight civs like French, you will want to alter this build and go Spearmen + Torguud in Feudal instead of massing Archers, even adding in Keshik if they mass their own Archers. Check out Pt2 of the below video for more info.
name: New Player Guide to Golden Horde
author: Shaada

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ makes @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ > @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ > @building_mongols/ger.webp@ @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Rally on @resource/sheep.webp@ until 8, then 2 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for 3 total.
Rallying back to @resource/resource_food.webp@, age up with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_khan_age2.webp@ when you can
Rally to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 10 total, then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ to 12. Get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ when you can.
Immediately get 2nd @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ and queue up @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ + @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ (you'll make @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ non-stop in Feudal)

Build a @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ near @resource/resource_gold.webp@, queue up @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ when you can, build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ by @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ and train @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ non-stop

Take 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ and go to @resource/deer.webp@ with @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ + @building_mongols/ger.webp@. Get @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@.

As @resource/resource_wood.webp@ begins to float, build @building_military/barracks.webp@ by @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ and train @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ (as needed) and at least 2 @unit_golden_horde/kharash.webp@

As @resource/resource_wood.webp@ floats even more, can slowly add @building_golden_horde/stockyard.webp@ and/or get @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ + @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@/@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@

Once feeling safe to age up, reassign @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ (based on feel) and age up with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_lumber_shields_age3.webp@

While waiting for the age up, get @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ (if not already), @technology_golden_horde/rotation_grazing.webp@, and add more @building_military/barracks.webp@ + @building_military/archery-range.webp@

Immediately get 3rd @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ , upgrade @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, train @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ + @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@/@unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ + @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ (+ @unit_golden_horde/kharash.webp@ if need), get @technology_military/balanced-projectiles.webp@/@technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@, and be aggressive!
